justification: Bo Nix put the ball on the ground in a game we lost, and I don't care that the boss just said he likes the kid — that's the code, he sits one week, end of discussion, we don't talk about it again after this. Kyler Murray gets the reins even banged up, because a rule's a rule or it's nothing. Javonte Williams scored twice last week so nobody touches him, he rides in the flex whether the spreadsheet likes it or not — that's not luck, that's a guy who's got something right now. LaPorta stays at tight end because he earned it against Buffalo's building, not because somebody upstairs suddenly discovered him. Pittman's got a Questionable next to his name and I'm starting him anyway — a guy who plays hurt is a guy who shows up, that's worth more to me than a clean bill of health from some scrub. Achane and Chase Brown keep their jobs, Boutte's the best wideout I got on the bench market, and the defense and kicker ride as-is. Second-to-last place stings, and there's moves coming this week — but the guys who earned their spot Sunday morning aren't the problem.
